summary: This is a routine 6-K filing by Ferroglobe PLC providing notice of its 2026 Annual General Meeting (AGM) to be held on June 17, 2026, along with the Annual Report for fiscal year 2025. The filing contains standard meeting logistics, a list of ordinary resolutions, and a board recommendation to vote in favor. There are no special-situation elements such as mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, management changes, or strategic reviews. As a foreign private issuer, the 6-K serves as a notification of annual meeting procedures, analogous to a proxy statement in the US, but does not involve any corporate action triggering a special situation classification.
